item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 31/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will form this morning and move across the coast of Guangdong on Friday morning. It will be windy and becoming cool appreciably over the region. The weather will be rather cool with some rain from Saturday to Sunday morning. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 31/03 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods. Hot in the afternoon. Coastal mist at night.
Temp range: 21 - 28 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
